checks.entity_identity: Narrative: "In Yellowstone zijn wolven sociale jagers". Evidence: "In Yellowstone, average pack size is 11.8 individuals." The place and animal referents are consistent.
checks.temporal_relationship: Narrative: "de verhouding tussen deze groepen keerde om tussen 1995–2000 en 2001–2007." Evidence: "That ratio reversed from 2001 to 2007". The sequence and timing are accurate.
checks.actor_object: Narrative: "hun prooien leveren voedsel aan dieren van raven en coyotes tot beren en ongewervelden." Evidence: "Many other animals benefit from wolf kills." The source says wolf kills, not prey in general, provide this food.
checks.causal_relationship: Narrative: "veranderingen in predatie en de invloed op elanden samenhangen met meerdere omstandigheden." Evidence: "Consequently, changes in prey selection and kill rates through time result from complex interactions among these factors." The narrative preserves the qualified, multi-factor relationship.
checks.quantitative_meaning: Narrative: "de verhouding tussen deze groepen keerde om tussen 1995–2000 en 2001–2007." Evidence: "From 1995 to 2000, in early winter, elk calves comprised 50% of wolf prey, and bull elk comprised 25%." No material quantity or statistical-scope distortion.
